tools.name: shirtigo_get_account
tools.description: Return the Shirtigo account behind the API key: name, company, country, user group, billing validity and integration count. Good first call to confirm the connection. Cockpit API: GET /user.

tools.name: shirtigo_list_projects
tools.description: List product collections (projects) of the account, newest first by default. A project groups the products built from its base products and designs. Cockpit API: GET /projects.

tools.name: shirtigo_get_project
tools.description: Return one project (collection) by its reference, including its status and processing areas. Cockpit API: GET /projects/{reference}.

tools.name: shirtigo_list_products
tools.description: List the account's finished or in-progress products (base product + design combinations), with optional filters by project, design, base product, tag or name search. Cockpit API: GET /products.

tools.name: shirtigo_get_product
tools.description: Return one product by its numeric id, optionally with live stock per variant. Cockpit API: GET /products/{product-id}.

tools.name: shirtigo_list_base_products
tools.description: Search the Shirtigo catalog of blank base products (shirts, hoodies, mugs, ...). Filter by category id or by SKU substring. Cockpit API: GET /base-products.

tools.name: shirtigo_get_base_product
tools.description: Return one base product by id, with its colors and sizes. Cockpit API: GET /base-products/{base-product-id}.

tools.name: shirtigo_list_categories
tools.description: List the category ids of the base product catalog (use them to filter shirtigo_list_base_products). Cockpit API: GET /base-categories.

tools.name: shirtigo_list_designs
tools.description: List the print designs (motifs) uploaded to the account. A design is reused across products. Cockpit API: GET /designs.

tools.name: shirtigo_get_design
tools.description: Return one design by reference: file info, colors, preview URLs and processing status. Cockpit API: GET /designs/{design-reference}.

tools.name: shirtigo_create_design_from_url
tools.description: Upload a print design to the account from a public image URL. It creates a new design record only; no product is ordered. Cockpit API: POST /designs/url.

tools.name: shirtigo_create_project
tools.description: Create an empty project (product collection) that later receives products. It is a new account record; no product is ordered. Cockpit API: POST /projects.

tools.name: shirtigo_predict_order_price
tools.description: Calculate the total price (products, shipping, VAT) for a planned order of existing products by SKU, without placing an order. Cockpit API: POST /orders/predict-price.

tools.name: shirtigo_list_orders
tools.description: List orders placed by the account, paginated. Filter by order status id and sort the list. Cockpit API: GET /orders.

tools.name: shirtigo_get_order
tools.description: Return one order by its reference: status, prices, delivery address, products and shipments. Cockpit API: GET /orders/{order_reference}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shirtigo_get_design · Private data: shirtigo_get_account, shirtigo_get_design, shirtigo_create_design_from_url, shirtigo_create_project · Public sink: shirtigo_create_design_from_url, shirtigo_create_project, shirtigo_predict_order_price.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shirtigo_get_design · Private data: shirtigo_get_account, shirtigo_get_design, shirtigo_create_design_from_url, shirtigo_create_project · Public sink: shirtigo_create_design_from_url, shirtigo_create_project, shirtigo_predict_order_price

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
